description.value: Smokin' George's BBQ is a Southern-style BBQ restaurant in Nanaimo rated in the top 10% of restaurants worldwide by Tripadvisor. They smoke meats on-site for up to 14 hours using fresh, locally-sourced Island Good ingredients, with options spanning brisket, pulled pork, ribs, and smoked chicken. Cyclists can dine in, grab takeout, or pick up fresh and frozen BBQ items to take on the road.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at smokingeorgesbbq.com loaded successfully and confirms an open, operating restaurant at 4131 Mostar Rd #5, Nanaimo, BC with phone (250) 585-2258. Takeout is explicitly offered ('Dine in, take out') and a Vegetarian sandwich (falafel patty) appears on the menu. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone number; both sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible BBQ restaurant with active website, confirmed address, and regular operating hours.
